originalTitle: Larry Page, Sergey Brin get $15 billion richer as Warren Buffett says Alphabet bet was his call
simplifiedContent: Warren Buffett, a well-known investor, said he personally decided to invest in Alphabet, the company that owns Google. This made Alphabet's stock price go up by almost 4%, which means the company is now worth more. As a result, the two men who co-founded Google, Larry Page and Sergey Brin, became $15 billion richer. This is significant because it shows that a major investor like Buffett has confidence in Alphabet's future, which can affect how other investors feel about the company. Buffett's investment company, Berkshire Hathaway, now owns a significant amount of Alphabet stock, which is a sign of its importance to the company's portfolio.

originalTitle: Tech Mahindra Q1 Results: Net profit rises 28% YoY to Rs 1,465 crore, revenue up 18%
simplifiedContent: Tech Mahindra, a major IT company, just released its financial results for the first quarter. The company made a net profit of Rs 1,465 crore, which is 28% more than it made in the same quarter last year. This is a significant increase, showing that the company is performing well financially. The company's revenue, or the amount of money it made from its operations, also increased by 18% compared to last year, reaching Rs 15,712 crore. This strong performance is a positive sign for the company and its investors.

originalTitle: Wipro Q1 Results: Profit flat YoY at Rs 3,352 crore; co declares Rs 2/share dividend
simplifiedContent: Wipro, a big IT company, recently shared its financial results for the first quarter of the year. The company's profit was almost the same as last year, at Rs 3,352 crore, but its revenue grew by 11%. Wipro also announced that it will pay a dividend of Rs 2 per share to its investors. The company is being cautious about its future performance, expecting its revenue to stay the same or slightly decrease in the next quarter. This news matters because it shows how Wipro is performing and what investors can expect from the company in the near future.

originalTitle: Tech Mahindra Q1 Results 2026: Consolidated net profit rises over 28% to  ₹1,465 crore, revenue up 15% - Key takeaways
simplifiedContent: Tech Mahindra, a technology company, recently released its financial results for the first quarter of 2026. The company's profit increased by 28.4% to ₹1,465.1 crore compared to the same time last year. This means the company made more money than it did a year ago. The company's revenue, which is the total amount of money it earned from its operations, also increased by 15% to ₹15,605.50 crore. This increase in profit and revenue is a positive sign for the company, indicating that its business is doing well.

originalTitle: Wipro Q1 results: Profit remains flat YoY at  ₹3,352 crore; declares interim dividend of  ₹2
simplifiedContent: Wipro, a big company, just released its quarterly financial results. The company's profit stayed almost the same as last year, at ₹3,352 crore, which is only a 0.65% increase. However, its revenue (the total amount of money it made) went up by 10.6% compared to last year, reaching ₹24,478.6 crore. This means that while the company made more money, its profit didn't increase as much as its revenue did. The company also decided to give its shareholders an interim dividend of ₹2, which is a small payment to the people who own its shares.

originalTitle: Reliance Q1 Results Preview: O2C, Jio to drive earnings - Key things to watch out for
simplifiedContent: Reliance Industries, a big company, is going to share its financial results for the first quarter of the year on July 17. People who follow the company think its oil and chemical business, as well as its telecom business (called Jio), will help its earnings grow. The company's retail business might not do as well because people aren't spending as much as they used to. The company's total revenue is expected to be between ₹3.09 and ₹3.20 trillion. This matters because it will give investors an idea of how well the company is doing and whether they should consider investing in it.
